rv.q: However, as a work of art, the play feels overstuffed and underdeveloped.
Most of the problems with Anthony M. Laura’s new play Duality might have been solved had someone else been piloting the transition from page to stage.
Duality brings hope into a dark world and validates just how much psychology as a field has progressed.

cn.t: Critics find this mental health drama well-intentioned but flawed, with mixed praise for its psychological insights undermined by concerns about underdeveloped execution and the playwright's self-direction.
